jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Global Payouts
jobs.description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Ripple's cross-border payment offering that enables global institutions to bridge stablecoins and fiat instantly.

This person will lead the roadmap driving the next phase of growth for our flagship payouts products. They will use the power of digital assets and blockchain to bridge traditional financial infrastructure. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Sales and Account Management, Risk/Fraud, Finance, Compliance, and Legal to build payment experiences that are customer-first, resilient, and built to scale.

The ideal candidate has deep payments expertise and a strong curiosity about digital assets. You're a problem solver; you work best when you're driving early stage solutions to achieve next-level scale. You'll excel working in a fast-past environment, and you are adept at and handling cross-functional initiatives across geographies.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Product Strategy and Vision: Define and communicate a product vision, strategy and roadmap for our Global Payouts product.

- Product Quality and Delivery: Partner with engineering to ensure clear requirements, strong acceptance criteria, and high-quality launches..

- Payments Experience: Lead the end-to-end payments experience across Ripple payouts, crafting capabilities that balance customer experience, conversion, and regulatory controls.

- Cross-functional Leadership: Lead high-impact initiatives and align collaborators across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk/Fraud, and Operations; remove blockers and drive decisions.

- Collaborator Management and Influence: Deliver concise, committed communication to ensure alignment and drive outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

- 12-15 years of total professional experience in financial services, fintech, or the crypto industry, with at least 5-10 years in a core product management role.

- A passion for payments and a deep curiosity about digital assets and blockchain.

- Demonstrated track record of scaling and evangelizing successful products

- Ability to translate complex topics into clear, concise language for different audiences.

- Strong technical competence and understanding.

- A knack for establishing relationships and driving alignment across teams with different priorities.

We’re looking for a senior product leader to shape the future of payments and financial applications on the XRP Ledger.

In this role, you’ll own product strategy and execution across areas such as stablecoin payments, on-chain liquidity and foreign exchange, and emerging forms of programmable commerce. You’ll work at the intersection of blockchain infrastructure, financial markets, and real-world customer needs - turning new capabilities into products and experiences that can achieve meaningful adoption.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work closely with engineering, business development, ecosystem partners, and customers to identify the most important problems to solve, develop a clear product strategy, and drive complex initiatives from concept through market adoption.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Own product strategy and roadmap for key payments and on-chain financial capabilities on the XRP Ledger

- Partner closely with Engineering to translate market and customer needs into scalable product and protocol capabilities

- Work with financial institutions, payment providers, liquidity providers, developers, and other ecosystem participants to understand workflows and adoption barriers

- Lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Business Development, and external partners

- Define the capabilities and ecosystem requirements needed to deliver compelling end-to-end customer experiences

- Navigate technical, commercial, and market tradeoffs to drive clear decisions and maintain momentum

- Represent the product strategy internally and externally with customers, partners, and the broader ecosystem

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

- Significant product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, trading, or other technically complex products

- Proven ability to define product strategy and lead ambiguous, high-impact initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption

- Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of driving alignment across technical and commercial organizations

- Strong technical fluency and experience working closely with engineering teams on backend, infrastructure, API, or protocol-level products

- Deep customer orientation and the ability to translate complex financial workflows into clear product opportunities

- Strong systems thinking and judgment across product, technology, market dynamics, and go-to-market considerations

- Excellent written and verbal communication, particularly when simplifying complex problems and driving decisions across diverse stakeholders

- Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the market, technology, and customer needs are still evolving

Nice to Have:

- Experience in payments, FX, liquidity, settlement, treasury, or financial market infrastructure

- Experience building crypto, blockchain, or stablecoin products

- Familiarity with wallets, digital assets, on-chain transactions, and decentralized or electronic trading systems

- Experience with developer platforms, open-source ecosystems, or protocol-level product development

- Experience launching products that depend on adoption across multiple ecosystem participants

The work:

We're seeking a dedicated, passionate, and eager Principal Technical Program Manager to join our team responsible for leading large cross-functional programs linked to our Products. This role reports to the Head of TPM within Ripple Core. This is a challenging and technical role, requiring the expertise to synthesize business and technical requirements and the foresight to ensure we are solving for Ripple's current and future customer needs. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams to design robust and scalable systems, lead product schedules, remove roadblocks, and ensure high development velocity. Ideal candidates have a track record of seeing around the corner and providing technical leadership to deliver for customers. You will be responsible for high-level strategy, but also know when to get hands-on to push an initiative forward. You must be passionate about enabling teams to invent and deliver customer-focused solutions to bold and ambiguous challenges.

What you'll do:

- Develop department-level priorities and strategy across strategic product initiatives by understanding our customers and technology deeply.

- Reduce ambiguity and risk by proactively identifying and eliminating bottlenecks and obstacles, raising issues strategically, and making sound data-driven decisions that deliver for our customers based on associated trade-offs.

- Communicate with purpose and clarity, bringing together cross-functional teams to achieve program objectives.

- Be a role model and an inspiring leader for other TPMs.

- Create technical frameworks that can be used by engineering teams for decision-making.

- Improve the efficiency of Operational Excellence processes across the organization.

- Partner with program managers, product managers, and engineering managers to understand development priorities and drive alignment across multiple partners with impactful priorities.

- Coordinate testing and release dependencies for assigned engineering teams, and across teams as products converge for release.

- Build release, bug, and progress-tracking dashboards to advise partners on development progress and gaps.

What you'll bring:

- 12+ years of previous release and/or technical program management experience on projects involving sophisticated enterprise tech environments, working directly with many teams across functions.

- Ability to use data and analytics to look at trends and lead health of projects and systems.

- Shown understanding and working knowledge of software development and modern project management standard processes, such as Agile, Scrum, Six Sigma, etc.

- Ability to coordinate multi-functionally, build consensus, and deliver across teams. Able to influence without authority, negotiate, and encourage others in a matrixed environment.

- Experience with project planning tools such as Jira and Confluence, and proficiency in Google Sheets.

- Experience crafting or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems.

jobs.description:

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

We are seeking a dedicated and ambitious Product Operations Analyst to join our dynamic team in New York, USA. This is an outstanding opportunity to be part of an exceptionally innovative company that is redefining the finance industry worldwide. Reporting to the Product Operations Manager, you will play a key role in supporting the growth and scaling of Ripple’s diverse product offerings. You will work closely with important internal teams such as Product, Trading, Risk, Treasury, and Engineering to make execution reliable, fast, and repeatable and to provide seamless support for Ripple’s 24x7 operations. Your responsibilities will include managing all operational support activities, including reconciliation, trade support, exception processing, and funding and settlement. You will also contribute significantly to developing and managing processes, system configurations, and settlement instructions, ensuring full alignment with our risk management framework, policies, and procedures.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Trading, and Treasury to ensure timely settlement of crypto and fiat funds across products

- Reconcile positions and balances for various business operations, including company-issued stablecoins.

- Understand risks and requirements for different asset types, including cryptocurrencies, to ensure quick responses to market activity and exceptions.

- Record transactions in systems to maintain accurate bookkeeping entries reflecting product and operational activities within Ripple’s systems of record.

- Become an expert in finance operational flows by working with key collaborators to detail existing processes.

- Support a globally distributed customer base for our 24x7 product offerings, including customer activity on weekends and holidays.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

- Relevant hands-on experience in operations and settlement, including reconciliation.

- Proven experience in monitoring venues and systems in real-time to uncover and resolve exceptions, breaks, and blocking issues.

- Willingness to work a weekend shift pattern as required. Our team operates during agreed business hours in shifts aligned to your region across a global follow-the-sun model.

- High attention to detail with the ability to problem-solve and remain organised in a dynamic environment.

- Dedicated with a passion for efficiency and continuous improvement.

- Experience with implementing off-the-shelf and in-house solutions.

- Broad understanding of markets and instruments (cleared, OTC, crypto, derivatives).

- Familiarity with generally accepted accounting principles is an advantage.

- Experience with SQL and crafting queries for daily operations is a plus.

- Experience with Agentic tools, ideally Claude or similar

Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

We are seeking a dedicated and ambitious Product Operations Specialist to join our dynamic team in Singapore. This is an outstanding opportunity to be part of an exceptionally innovative company that is transforming how value moves across borders for financial institutions worldwide. You will play a key role in supporting the growth and scaling of Ripple's diverse product offerings. You will work closely with important internal teams such as Markets, Risk, Treasury, and Legal to provide seamless support for Ripple's 24x7 operations. Your responsibilities will include managing all operational support activities, including reconciliation, trade support, exception processing, and funding and settlement. You will also contribute significantly to developing and managing processes, system configurations, and settlement instructions, ensuring full alignment with our risk management framework, policies, and procedures.

Your Growth Path:
You'll begin with reconciliation and settlement support, then expand into process automation, system configuration, and cross-product expertise as you demonstrate impact. You'll receive structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to build deep expertise in crypto operations, risk management, and process design.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Collaborate with Finance and Operations teams, as well as external customers, to ensure timely settlement of crypto and fiat funds.

- Reconcile positions and balances for various business operations, including company-issued stablecoin.

- Monitor intraday trading and settlement activity in close partnership with the Ripple Trading and Markets team.

- Understand risks and requirements for different asset types, including cryptocurrencies, to ensure quick responses to market activity and exceptions.

- Record transactions in systems to maintain accurate bookkeeping entries reflecting product and operational activities within Ripple's systems of record.

- Become an expert in finance operational flows by working with key collaborators to detail existing processes.

- Identify manual processes that can be automated or streamlined, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

- Willingness to work a weekend/holiday shift pattern as required. Our team operates during agreed business hours in shifts aligned to your region across a global follow-the-sun model.

- Relevant hands-on experience in operations, clearing, and settlement, including reconciliation.

- Proven experience in monitoring venues and systems in real-time to uncover and resolve exceptions, breaks, and blocking issues.

- Understanding of accounting principles (debits/credits, balance sheet reconciliation) is strongly preferred.

- Curiosity and initiative to identify manual processes that can be automated or streamlined.

- High attention to detail with the ability to problem-solve and remain organized in a dynamic environment.

- Dedicated with a passion for efficiency and continuous improvement.

- Experience with implementing off-the-shelf and in-house solutions.

- Broad understanding of markets and instruments (cleared, OTC, crypto, derivatives).

- Experience with SQL and crafting queries for daily operations is a plus.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

- The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders

- A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.

- Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.

- In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.

- Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team

- We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

- Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity

- Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support

- Employee giving match

- Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

- R&R days so you can rest and recharge

- Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming

- Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it

- Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.

- Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

We seek a Senior Staff Product Manager to lead and develop our Trust Platform — the programmable controls, integrations, and tools that enable our products to function securely and reliably as we grow into more regulated, higher-risk markets such as banks and other regulated entities.

You'll determine what features should be included in the platform and which ones become reusable components other teams can build upon. You will assess how the roadmap stands up to careful examination from regulators, bank diligence teams, and the product teams working on what you develop. You will work closely with Compliance, Legal, and Engineering, maintaining clear responsibility for the product roadmap and decisions.

Why Now?

- The regulatory landscape is growing. More jurisdictions, more counterparties, more edge cases — this needs someone thinking ahead of requirements, crafting our posture before it's forced on us.

- Trust is a competitive advantage. Our strategy increasingly points at selling into banks and other regulated counterparties, who diligence maturity, auditability, and programmable controls as part of the buying decision. This work helps us secure agreements.

- The platform opportunity is genuine and ready to develop. We have reached a stage where this logic should become a configurable core element for other teams to build upon. It involves deciding what is configurable, what forms an API, and the sequencing order. This is a true product invention challenge that requires focused attention.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Own the roadmap for some of our highest-stakes regulatory surfaces. Get ahead of new jurisdictions and requirements. Build something durable enough to hold up to bank-grade diligence.

- Define the scope and develop the Trust Platform by deciding which components should be reusable. Identify the initial use case(s). Manage the balance between flexibility and control as other teams build upon it.

- Build tooling for information-request and review workflows that scales across product lines, rather than requiring headcount growth to keep pace with volume.

- Collaborate across departments with Compliance, Legal, and Engineering to translate regulatory and risk requirements into product decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

- 5-7 years of experience in fintech, crypto, or another regulated technology space. Significant tenure as a Product Manager, including work at a Staff or Senior Staff level.

- A history of developing and expanding platform products — reusable primitives and APIs that other teams rely on.

- Experience in compliance, risk, trust and safety, or another high-stakes regulatory domain, with the technical depth to reason about system build and tradeoffs.

- Ability to operate independently across a wide collaborator matrix — Compliance, Legal, Engineering, and other product teams — while retaining clear product ownership.

- Comfort prioritizing and building something new in a high-ambiguity environment.

If you want to define what a trust and risk platform looks like at scale, we'd love to talk.

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

The work:

We're seeking a dedicated, passionate, and eager Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to join our team responsible for leading Ripple's Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) migration program. This is a challenging and technical role, requiring the expertise to synthesize business and technical requirements and the foresight to ensure we are solving for Ripple's current and future security needs ahead of Q-Day. You will work closely with InfoSec, XRPL Core, Payments, Custody, Stablecoin, Platform, Compliance, and Legal to drive a company-wide cryptographic migration across asymmetric ciphers, symmetric ciphers, hashing functions, and digital signatures. You will partner with InfoSec on the high-level strategy, but also know when to get hands-on to push an initiative forward. You must be passionate about enabling teams to invent and deliver security-focused solutions to bold and ambiguous challenges.

What you'll do:

- Drive execution of Ripple's PQC program end-to-end, from cryptographic asset inventory through risk prioritization, tradeoff analysis, and migration execution, against a Q-Day-readiness target of the end of 2028.

- Stand up and own a cross-org PQC working group with named owners across XRPL Core, Payments, Custody, Stablecoin, Platform, and InfoSec.

- Drive alignment with vendors and partners (custody partners, exchanges, payment processors, HSM vendors) on compatible PQC roadmaps, escalating gaps.

- Reduce ambiguity and risk by proactively identifying and eliminating bottlenecks and obstacles, raising issues strategically, and making sound data-driven decisions that deliver for our customers based on associated trade-offs.

- Communicate program status, risk, and progress with purpose and clarity to engineering leadership and executive sponsors, including maintaining the program dashboard reviewed monthly by execs.

- Be a role model and an inspiring leader for other TPMs.

- Create technical frameworks that can be used by engineering teams for decision-making.

- Influence & improve the efficiency of Operational Excellence processes org-wide.

- Partner with program managers, product managers, and engineering managers to understand development priorities and drive alignment across multiple partners with impactful priorities.

- Coordinate testing and release dependencies for assigned engineering teams, and across teams as products converge for release.

- Build migration-progress, risk-register, and readiness dashboards to advise partners and leadership of progress and gaps.

What you'll bring:

- 10+ years of program management experience on initiatives involving sophisticated enterprise tech environments, working directly with many teams across functions.

- Solid understanding of cryptographic fundamentals (asymmetric/symmetric ciphers, hashing, digital signatures) sufficient to synthesize technical tradeoffs with engineering and InfoSec stakeholders.

- Prior exposure to PQC, cryptographic migrations, or security/compliance-driven technical programs is a strong plus.

- Ability to use data and analytics to look at trends and lead health of projects and systems.

- Ability to coordinate multi-functionally, build consensus, and execute across teams. Able to influence without authority, negotiate, and encourage others in a matrixed environment.

- Experience with Jira and Confluence, and proficiency in Google Sheets.

- Experience crafting or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems.

- Experience in Payments, Custody, Stablecoin, and/or Blockchain ecosystems.
